rule: Share the contract, not the vendor runtime. Claude uses CLAUDE.md, settings.json registrations, native one-level skills, recursive Markdown agents, and explicit DreamerOS MCP calls.

members: UserPromptSubmit dreameros_turn_check.py (gateway check on every message)
Local tools or an exposed DreamerOS MCP tool
DreamerOS receipt and handoff when available
Offline Repo and Git when authorized

session_flow: UserPromptSubmit repeats the session-package requirement until a transcript shows a real MCP call, then surfaces the narrowest matching skills.
Stop holds an open receipt process that has no explicit tie or terminal state.
A hook file is not active unless settings.json registers it.
package_scope: Portable source payload. No credentials, sessions, caches, transcript data, whole repositories, or customer runtime state are included.
